verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a machine-readable OpenAPI document (HTTP 200 at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json, containing an "openapi" key), and Warp positions itself as an API/CLI/SDK/MCP platform with an API reference section. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the spec's scope and coverage of the cloud-agent API, evidence of versioning or completeness, independent hands-on use of the spec beyond its existence.
